name: Sparkling
ability: Murmuration (its own: from level 20, while above a quarter of its HP, it calls its flock and fights in its Swarm Form)
look: a tiny round black starling with a yellow hood and crest, huge glowing magenta eyes in a dark mask, white wing patches and thin pale legs
entry: Alone it is a timid little bird that sparks when startled. When danger comes it calls, and thousands of Sparklings pour out of the sky and fly as one giant bird, crackling with their combined charge.
how: Wild: common in plains, grasslands and forests, and everywhere during thunderstorms.
Swarm Form: in battle, from level 20, while its HP is above a quarter, its ability Murmuration calls its flock and it becomes a ~20-block-tall bird made of thousands of Sparklings (like Wishiwashi).
